880-6517-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-6517-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1479-1671-8338.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, Shuttlecraft Galileo, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-5170-6132-8292.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2226-2499-4576.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2499-4576.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Yarok.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Fleetfoot Panther by paying its mana cost.
When Fleetfoot Panther enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

339-677-969-8095.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2557-3129-6441-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2921-7940--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Support Mission triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat

1479-3257-7892.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Thranduil the Strategist, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

301-4738-5805.easyPrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
301-4738-5805.description:
Activate Goblin Sledder by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve the Goblin Sledder ability.
Repeat.

997-1263-1417-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

215-3443-4785.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-3443-4785.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-3443-4785.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

2034-4742-5477-5660-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2349-2724-3080-5299.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Mistmeadow Witch by paying {2}{W}{U}, exiling and returning (at end step) Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

5220-5332-6505-6900.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Carmen trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2191-7070-7444.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Monk Gyatso.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend it.
Resolve Martyrdom.
Activate Monk Gyatso by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
Monk Gyatso's ability from step 4 fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Advanced Reconstruction.
Repeat from step 4.

7-1020-2034-2866.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature excluding Myr Retriever that has a +1/+1 counter on it
7-1020-2034-2866.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Hamza.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Hamza.
Repeat.

2034-4871-6005-6967-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Malevolent Chandelier by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Honest Rutstein.
Repeat.

2866-3200-4779-4986.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

654-2608-2882-5256-6644.manaNeeded: {G}{W}{U} plus an additional {1} if you've cast Derevi from the command zone this game
654-2608-2882-5256-6644.description:
If you haven't cast Derevi from the command zone this game, cast it by paying {G}{W}{U}. Otherwise, activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Derevi enters the battlefield as a copy of Ancient Adamantoise due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Derevi.
Choose to return Derevi from your graveyard to the command zone.
When Derevi dies, it triggers, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{W}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

198-4067-6100-6281.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Elvish Regrower.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Elvish Regrower that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Elvish Regrower token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Elvish Regrower from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

requires.n: Nonartifact, Nonlegendary Creature with a Generic Mana Cost

392-2232-4313-5866--98.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the creature with a generic mana cost either for its mana cost or for its emerge cost.
392-2232-4313-5866--98.description:
Cast the creature with a generic mana cost by paying its mana cost or emerge cost.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Flameshadow Conjuring trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Flameshadow Conjuring trigger, choosing to pay {R} to create a token copy of the generic mana cost creature.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the nontoken generic mana cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast the generic mana cost creature for its emerge cost by sacrificing the creature token created in step 5, and by paying {0} as the token will have the same mana value.
Repeat from step 2.

2131-5436-5660.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature or artifact card in your graveyard.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
2131-5436-5660.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning an artifact or creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Thran Vigil triggers. Holding priority, activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding an artifact or creature card.
Resolve the Thran Vigil ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Repeat from step 2.

1750-1979-3617-5261.notablePrerequisites: Efreet Flamepainter does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1750-1979-3617-5261.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Efreet Flamepainter.
Efreet Flamepainter triggers, causing you to cast Time Walk from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile it.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Time Walk from exile into your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

requires.n: Instant or Sorcery with Mana Cost = {R}

1031-1170-5293--26.description:
Cast Rite of Flame by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for another instant or sorcery with mana cost equal to {R} and putting it into your hand.
Resolve Rite of Flame, adding {R}{R}.
Cast the other instant or sorcery by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rite of Flame from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the other instant or sorcery spell.
Repeat.

3693-5113-5220.description:
Cast Walking Ballista either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Walking Ballista on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

811-2757-4222-5169.notablePrerequisites:
Daring Thief does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Daring Thief.
You control a basic Island.
An opponent controls at least one creature.
811-2757-4222-5169.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Daring Thief, untapping the Island.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Daring Thief.
Daring Thief triggers, exchanging control of Khârn the Betrayer and any creature.
Khârn the Betrayer triggers, causing the player who lost control of it to draw two cards.
Repeat.

3090-4126-4158.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
3090-4126-4158.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying {2}{R}, giving an opponent control of Nefarious Lich.
Activate Staff of Compleation's first ability by tapping it and paying 1 life, destroying Nefarious Lich.
When Nefarious Lich leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing its controller to lose the game.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1796-1824-4156.notablePrerequisites:
Centaur Omenreader is tapped.
You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation.
392-1796-1824-4156.description:
Cast Acererak for {B}.
Brigi triggers, adding {R}.
Acererak enters the battlefield, triggering.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it to your hand and venturing into the Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Each time you trigger the Dark Pool room ability, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
Activate Agent of Stormgald for {R} to add {B}.
Repeat.

914-5140-5256.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-5140-5256.description:
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dockside Extortionist's power.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}.
Repeat.
914-5140-5256.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2935-3350-4695.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Axis of Mortality triggers.
Activate Ethereal Champion by paying 1 life, preventing the next one damage that will be dealt to Ethereal Champion this turn.
Repeat step 2 until you have zero life.
Resolve the Axis of Mortality trigger, swapping your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this on each of your turns.
